data.name: Tsunami Burst
data.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can invoke this blessing as an immediate action. A wave of water blasts out from you at your attacker, attempting a bull rush combat maneuver check using your CMB but adding your Wisdom modifier instead of your Strength modifier.
